policy: Runners are execution surfaces, not project controllers. Use IKE-specific agent profiles and bounded packets. Give each delegate enough tool permission to complete its lane, then constrain behavior with allowed files, forbidden actions, validation, and review gates.

dispatch_rules.rule: Every controller-authored openclaw agent --agent <id> delegated execution must include a fresh explicit session UUID (--session-id <new-guid>). Do not reuse default sessions for bounded task packets. A session may be resumed only when the controller explicitly intends continuation of the same task.
dispatch_rules.rationale: Concurrent delegated turns that reuse the agent's default session collide on shared session state, causing EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError and prompt lock release.
dispatch_rules.dispatch_surface_note: All controller-authored OpenClaw delegate dispatches MUST use invoke_openclaw_delegate.ps1. Direct openclaw.cmd invocation without session isolation is forbidden.

coding_worker.minimum_capability: read context, edit packet-allowed files, run validation commands, and write the result artifact
coding_worker.boundary: allowed files and stop conditions in the task packet

ui_worker.minimum_capability: edit packet-allowed frontend files, run build/smoke validation, and write the result artifact
ui_worker.boundary: no backend semantics changes unless explicitly authorized

test_runner.minimum_capability: run tests, browser probes, and write test evidence artifacts
test_runner.boundary: no source edits unless a separate implementation packet authorizes fixes

runtime_operator.minimum_capability: inspect processes, run authorized runtime commands, and write runtime result artifacts
runtime_operator.boundary: no source edits or dependency changes unless explicitly authorized

reviewer.minimum_capability: read diffs/artifacts, run read-only checks, and write review artifacts
reviewer.boundary: no source edits and no promotion decision

runners.automatic_trigger: via Codex automation or external trigger only
forbidden: accept own work without required review gate
